Settings

Configure document conversion, monitoring, startup and updates.

Word document templates and branding

Standard preserves the original appearance. Native uses minimal Word styles. Custom imports only validated .dotx styles and theme (not embedded master-page contents).

PDF export

Automatic Word conversion

Monitoring continues in the Windows tray when the application window is closed. Use Exit in the tray to stop MDTranscode.

Use the same folder to keep Markdown and Word files together, or choose separate folders. Missing folders are created when you enable monitoring and save. Separate folders cannot be nested inside each other.

Windows integration

Use the tray menu to pause, open folders, check status or exit when close-to-tray is enabled.

Startup is off by default. Use Windows Settings to choose whether MDTranscode opens when you sign in.
